name: Ciao synthetic WIC user-level pilot
status: Initial three-seed HIM run completed; freeze jointly before cross-method results

diffusion.edge_probability: For each undirected edge {u,v}, use p(u,v)=p(v,u)=1/max(degree(u),degree(v)).
diffusion.rationale: A topology-derived fixed probability bank avoids selecting a uniform probability range without evidence on this denser graph; the symmetric rule makes the sum of incident edge probabilities at each node no greater than one.
diffusion.interpretation: Synthetic diffusion on the Ciao trust topology; not measured real-world information adoption or a claim about Ciao's true transmission probabilities.

him.training_seed_sampling: HIM degree mode samples the training seed set from the top 20% of users by degree.
him.within_training_loop_evaluation: Pipeline validation only; do not report it as an independent result.

initial_run.interpretation: One training seed and a checkpoint selected using within-training simulator evaluations; not a cross-method or multi-seed conclusion.

independent_evaluation.rule: After training and checkpoint selection, reset Python random and NumPy RNG to the replicate-specific seed before evaluating each seed set. Use the same replicate-specific seed for each method; keep the edge-probability bank fixed and separate training and evaluation random streams.

initial_three_seed_summary.interpretation: Exploratory three-seed estimate; the interval includes zero and has only 2 degrees of freedom. It is not evidence of selector superiority or cross-method performance.
